pr_body:
Closes #20863 and improves scaling behaviour with `SDL_VIDEODRIVER=wayland`.

I find that the hardware cursors don't work properly under Wayland (graphical corruption on the main menu and inconsistent switching between cursor types ingame) but I suspect/hope that this is an SDL issue rather than OpenRA.
pr_comments: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/learnwin32/dpi-and-device-independent-pixels suggests that windows can also use device-independent pixels, but its not clear how (or if) the referenced `ID2D1RenderTarget` methods map into the SDL world.

Doesn't work for me on KDE:

Yes, it does. I need to specify, that I don't have a issue with just few pixels, but much larger discrepancy. I also just determined, it's behave like this for me with fractional scaling, that I use on my laptop.

I have 14" laptop with 1440p resolution, and both 100% and 200% resolution scale is unusable for me, therefore I'm using 150%. And with this scale and fullscreen game, I basically can't click on any button. Once I'm in game and change to window mode, game again start to recognize the right position of mouse cursor and I can control the game normally.
